intro.content: Place the block in the product section, ideally just above the buy button. The date and texts are only shown for variants on pre-order.

boxed.label: Show in a box
boxed.info: A thin border in the theme's text colour around date, count, timeline and waitlist. Off: the same content without a border.

shipping_label.label: Name for expected shipping
shipping_label.info: Shown in the message and as a line item property in cart, checkout, order confirmation and on the order. Default: “Expected to ship”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

delivery_label.label: Name for expected delivery
delivery_label.info: Used when the app is set to expected delivery. Default: “Expected delivery”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

message.label: Message
message.info: {label} becomes the name above, {date} the delivery date. Default: “{label}: {date}”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

note.label: Explanation
note.info: Makes the terms clear before purchase. Default: “This item is on pre-order. You won't be charged until it ships.” Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.
note.placeholder: This item is on pre-order. You won't be charged until it ships.

sold_out_message.label: Message when everything is sold out
sold_out_message.info: Default: “Sold out, all deliveries are sold out.” Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.
sold_out_message.placeholder: Sold out, all deliveries are sold out.

change_button_text.label: Change the buy button text
change_button_text.info: Off: the block shows its own message above the button, and the theme's button is left alone.

button_text.label: Buy button text
button_text.info: Default: “Pre-order”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

show_remaining.label: Show remaining in the current delivery
show_remaining.info: The number is fetched fresh from the app after the page loads. It is always the count in the delivery the customer is buying into now.

remaining_threshold.label: Only show the number at or below
remaining_threshold.info: E.g. 25: «Only 480 left» creates no urgency. It's just noise.

remaining_text.label: Text
remaining_text.info: {count} becomes the number. Default: “Only {count} left in this delivery.” Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

show_timeline.label: Show a timeline of the deliveries
show_timeline.info: Shows the current plan with expected dates and whether each delivery is sold out, the one being bought into now, or upcoming. No counts per delivery.

timeline_sold_out.label: Sold-out delivery
timeline_sold_out.info: Default: “sold out”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

timeline_current.label: The delivery being bought into now
timeline_current.info: Short text looks best. Default: “current”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

timeline_upcoming.label: Upcoming delivery
timeline_upcoming.info: Default: “upcoming”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

waitlist_intro.content: If the variant can neither be bought from stock nor pre-ordered, the customer can sign up to be notified when it can be bought. The notification is sent as an event to Shopify Flow, Klaviyo or your webhook. It may only be about the item. Offers, other products and discount codes require consent.

waitlist_heading.label: Heading
waitlist_heading.info: Default: “Get notified when it's available”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

waitlist_email_label.label: Field name
waitlist_email_label.info: Default: “Your email”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

waitlist_button.label: Button text
waitlist_button.info: Default: “Notify me”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

waitlist_success.label: Reply after sign-up
waitlist_success.info: Always shown after a sign-up, also if the email was already on the list. Default: “Thanks. We'll let you know when it's available.” Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.
waitlist_success.placeholder: Thanks. We'll let you know when it's available.

waitlist_invalid.label: Reply for an invalid email
waitlist_invalid.info: Default: “Enter a valid email.” Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

waitlist_error.label: Reply on error
waitlist_error.placeholder: That didn't work. Please try again shortly.
waitlist_error.info: Default: “That didn't work. Please try again shortly.” Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

waitlist_privacy.label: How the email is used
waitlist_privacy.placeholder: We only use your email to notify you about this item. You won't be subscribed to our newsletter.
waitlist_privacy.info: Default: “We only use your email to notify you about this item. You won't be subscribed to our newsletter.” Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

texts_info.content: The default text is shown under each field. Leave a field empty to show it in the customer's language (Danish or English). Your own text is shown as written in every language.

intro.content: Shows in the cart that pre-ordered items cost nothing today. Only shown when there is a pre-order in the cart. The default text is shown under each field. Leave a field empty to show it in the customer's language. Your own text is shown as written in every language.

line_note.label: Text under the item
line_note.placeholder: Nothing due today. The amount is charged when the item ships.
line_note.info: Default: “Nothing due today. The amount is charged when the item ships.” Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

show_totals.label: Show amounts above the checkout button

later_label.label: Amount charged later
later_label.info: Default: “Charged when the item ships”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.

today_label.label: Amount today
today_label.info: Default: “Due today”. Leave empty to use the default text in the customer’s language.
